title: Waves
author: Amit Shankar Saha
text:
At night waves of words come
from the shores of your books,
all frothing in meanings
with the foam of feelings.

I scoop up an ocean
in the cup of my mind,
you can hear the lapping
on the sands of my being.

Early in the morning
when I wake up I find
in the waves of my dreams
our wavelengths were one.
